messages:
emily: Quick Q — should onboarding be a separate billable SKU in marketplace listings or handled as consult via support invoice? Need decision for AWS submission (staging) tomorrow.

raj: My vote: include a one-time onboarding SKU (RW-MKT-ONBOARD) set to 'Contact us' for price. Easier for procurement.

karen: Agreed. AWS supports a one-time SKU with no price field. We just need copy: 'Professional services: onboarding & integration'.

tom: Slight caution: downstream billing teams prefer to keep PS off the marketplace for enterprise customers who need T&Cs. Can we mark SKU as optional and exclude from auto-accept?

emily: good point. Can we set it as 'private pricing' or 'contact us' so sales can negotiate?

marketplace-bot: Note: AWS marketplace metadata allows 'Contact Us' pricing and private offers. See https://console.aws.amazon.com/marketplace/help/privatesoffers

raj: Plan: create RW-MKT-ONBOARD with term=onetim, price=contact_us, visibility=public but sales can move to private offers when needed. I'll add `notes` field in CSV.

legal: Legal note: PS work needs separate SOW; marketplace listing should not imply included consultancy. Copy must say 'Professional services sold separately' and link to SOW contact.

sam_k: Growth/marketing input: in listing page let's add a short line 'Optional onboarding & migration services available' — keeps it non-committal but discoverable.

karen: I'll add CSV row and mark `EU_VAT_APPLIES` flag for onboarding conversions. Uploading to partnerships/marketplace-assets/sku-mapping-v3.csv now.

emily: thanks. Last item: support contact — marketplace-support@redwood.ai confirmed?

tom: yes. Also add support SLAs only for Dedicated entries; hosted listing must avoid SLA claims per legal.

marketplace-bot: Checklist: SKU CSV  uploaded, Onboarding SKU  created, Legal copy  pending link to SOW.

emily: OK team — we have enough to submit to AWS staging tomorrow. If legal can drop the SOW link today, we'll include it. Otherwise we'll submit and add it in the final step. Thanks! :thumbsup:
